description: Manage your users and their roles here.

help.title: About User list
help.overview: This list contains company members whose roles are marked as default for signup, plus members with no roles. It excludes the currently signed-in user and is separate from the Administration list.

sections.title: Add and manage members
items: Create a user with a password or invite someone by email.
Open the row menu to edit a member and their assigned roles.
Cards show account status, MFA, and invitation, activation, and password-reset requests.

sections.title: Who appears here
items: Default-for-signup roles place members in this Users list.
Staff and admin role packs that are not default for signup appear under Administration instead.

administrationHelp.title: About Administration users list
administrationHelp.overview: This list contains users with staff or administration role packs that are not marked as default for signup, plus bot users. The currently signed-in user is excluded.

sections.title: Add administrators
items: Create a user with a password or invite someone by email; the person receives an administration role.
Open the row menu to edit the account and its assigned roles.
Cards show account status, MFA, and invitation, activation, and password-reset requests.

sections.title: Separate from Users
items: Roles without the default-for-signup setting place people in Administration.
Regular company members with default-for-signup roles appear in Company → Users.
